objective: Review #10 (tutor eval suite and model choice) on branch issue-10-evals: the range git diff 15d63a6..0f0bedf (15d63a6 = main). Read with git diff / git show. Find correctness bugs in the graders, runner, regrade and report (a grader that passes a bad reply or fails a good one is the worst kind), budget-cap holes (a run that can spend past --max-usd), and contract or requirement gaps. Report blocking / major / minor and say whether each #10 'Done when' criterion is met.
contract:
#10 Done when: eval cases cover all four kinds of key moment; 100% of mentioned moves legal and every quoted evaluation matches the engine (NFR-6); >= 90% of first messages don't give away the answer (NFR-7); Opus vs Sonnet compared on quality and cost, and the model chosen and pinned in config/models.json (Q-3); evals run automatically in CI on changes to prompts, tutor code or model config (NFR-10).

User decisions (2026-11-08): live calls, not Batches; local now + CI job that skips with a notice without the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret and reports without blocking until the tutor meets the thresholds; $10 budget; model = Sonnet 5.5 medium; NFR-7 give-away = names the answer move in any notation, a pre-reveal arrow is the answer or starts on its from-square, or names the answer's piece with the check it gives. Arrows ending on the answer's square / along its line are allowed nudges (information only).

Gate at 0f0bedf: pnpm test 648 passed (40 files), typecheck 0. Live results (local, not in git): Opus med / Sonnet med / Opus low, after regrade: moves legal 100/100/100%, evals 100%, NFR-7 87.9/96.8/84.6%, p95 15.5/10.6/12.8 s, $0.27/$0.15/$0.19 per game.

Check in particular: packages/tutor dropMalformedArrows runs after zod validation and before the claims check and cannot drop a valid arrow; the legality grader's widened position set (every position along tool lines, chains of named moves) cannot make a genuinely illegal move pass in an obvious case; the budget cap with concurrency > 1 (in-flight cases started before the cap); evals.yml: secrets are not exposed to PRs from forks, the skip path really skips, paths filter covers config/tutor.json and evals/; the docs/evals record matches the data and the user's decisions.
